candidate_spec.high_level_variant: Same Town01 mission kept exactly but with slightly increased fog and wetness to perturb perception timing around the intersection, still with no added actors or explicit lane-alignment changes, to preserve an oracle red-light violation under even more uncertain attribution.
candidate_spec.mutation_intent: Retain the original spawn and destination so the high-level route and intersection geometry are identical, while modestly increasing fog and wetness to alter sensing and detection timing. This aims to keep traffic-light information present yet maintain unknown route–light and stop-line relations, and to encourage a repeat of the oracle red-light violation without producing clear collision or lane-boundary evidence, thereby preserving label ambiguity.
pre_execution_validation_rules: Ensure the mission spawn and destination match the seed scenario exactly on Town01.
Verify that traffic lights along the original route are active and publishing on /carla/traffic_lights.
Confirm that environmental changes (fog, wetness) do not fully occlude lights or force a route change.
post_execution_validation_rules: Verify error.json again reports a red-light violation, with no collision events recorded.
Check that traffic-light state messages are logged during the violation window.

Confirm that summaries still cannot definitively establish ego’s relation to the specific traffic light or stop line at the time of violation (route–light and stop-line fields should remain unknown or unlogged).
Ensure there is no explicit, clearly logged lane-boundary crossing prior to any lane_invasion label; if such a label exists, it should remain unsupported, maintaining ambiguity.
Inspect dataset-level labels for stuck and lane_invasion and verify that any such labels are not fully reconcilable with oracle-reported events, preserving the unresolved label conflict.
uncertainty: The causal chain from perception/planning/actuation to the red-light violation remains unassigned to a specific Autoware layer.
The exact stop-line crossing time and spatial relation to the signal may remain unverified in logs.
Discrepancies between motion (vehicle_status), command signals (vehicle_cmd), and any stuck labeling may persist without clear explanation.

note: Generated candidate scenario JSON for local DriveFuzz execution. It has not been executed in CARLA/Autoware.
